description: Discovers cheapest flight destinations from an origin city when the user has no specific destination in mind. Use for open-ended queries like 'where should I go?', 'cheapest flights from Dubai', 'surprise me', or 'best deals from Singapore'. Returns up to 15 cheapest destinations with prices, airlines, and travel dates. Do NOT use when user has a specific destination — use flights_search instead. Use IATA city codes from places_find_location.

currencyCode.description: The currency the user pays in, as an ISO 4217 code (e.g. 'SAR', 'INR', 'USD'): the one they ask for, else the currency of their own country (siteCode). Do NOT take it from the destination: a user in India booking Dubai pays in 'INR'. Send the same code on every flight and hotel call in this conversation, searchId reads included.

departureDate.description: Departure date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; API picks best dates if omitted.

locale.description: Locale for results (e.g., 'en', 'ar', 'zh'). If not provided, uses the locale from the user's settings. Supports BCP 47 format (e.g., 'ar-SA' resolves to 'ar').

origin.description: Departure city IATA code (e.g., DXB, SIN, LON)

returnDate.description: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; ignored for oneway trips.

name: flights_search_anywhere
title: Search Flights Anywhere
